verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these four kinds of bad conduct by way of speech.

verses.pali: Musāvādo, pisuṇā vācā, pharusā vācā, samphappalāpo—
verses.english: Speech that’s false, backbiting, harsh, or nonsensical.
These are the four kinds of bad conduct by way of speech.
There are these four kinds of good conduct by way of speech.

verses.pali: Saccavācā, apisuṇā vācā, saṇhā vācā, mantavācā—
verses.english: Speech that’s true, harmonious, gentle, and thoughtful.
These are the four kinds of good conduct by way of speech.”
